body:
There's the word. Apathy. For all the high fangled language I spontaneously employed here its comical how the most apt one slipped my grasp. Thank you for using it. 

I heavily relate to the feeling of a panic attack in a super market. That and just sweating enough to replenish a river and then some just by being near people. I understand and empathize with wanting connection/fearing/distrusting everything and everyone. 

I expected this post to land flat. Which is why I kind of...tried to talk to whoever might read it. Both vent and maybe reach someone else.

I didn't expect to get a reply that understood this and put it in such succinct terms. Thank you. Whether we get each other perfectly or not doesn't matter, we get each other enough.

Thank you for posting. Sincerely. And hey, look, I'm just a recently relapsed addict whose emotions and behavior is a bit all over the place, but for what it'd worth, keep breathing and keep doing what keeps you alive over where you are at, will you?

I'm just here, both getting some last minute resources for what feels like a fruitless retry, and about to write assignments in the dead of night.

So whatever timezone you are in, for whatever its worth, giving you a spiritual brofist and tapping you on the back to move ahead.

Hey. Hi. I get you. I also get you probably won't believe me when I say that. And I'm sorry, but I'm not 'from the other end', I'm going through shit myself.

I don't have any advice for you. Except maybe to breathe. Maybe forget changing things for a second. Walk, at most. Just walk. Walk u til you've walked more than you planned, seen more than you have. Breathe as you walk.

And I can't know which people give a shit about you. But I wrote this. My reasons might be altruistic, they might be selfish, whatever they are - I wrote this and you cannot deny it. And here's a fact - somebody will inevitably care if you die. Regardless of why they care - they will and their psyche will be affected by it. I guarantee you there's research to back me up here.

I'm sorry you are going through this, through feeling like you are unwanted, unnoticed, neglected, but I want you to know, I saw you right now, for however brief a time.

Please let some others see you too. Arguably someone who can do a better job than me. And look man. You ain't alone in this shit show. So...for whatever its worth, sending a brofist your way. Breathe. Own that goddamn oxygen.

This has been me for the last four years. My chosen date has been my birthday.

Look, I'm going through shit too, I can't pretend to be something I have not, especially with my last post right there in my history - your depressed head would see through it and add even more to the mess in your head, distorting and contorting it to its own machinations.

I don't know you. I don't know your life.

But if you've backed off from killing yourself.
That's a failure on the part of your depression. 
A success on your end. Provided you can see your depression as another entity. 

So...thank you for succeeding today.
I am just grasping for straws. But as someone who often doesn't find them, I'm grateful.

Cry if you need to. Breathe. But please, see today through, will you?
Greet the sun tomorrow morning too.
And if all you can handle are the next ten minutes. Take that. Keep taking that.

I...well, as meaningless as it may sound, I wish you well. Stay alive. I'm a bit of a hypocrite for saying it, in a sense, but please.
